- `_convert_responses_usage(usage)` — normalizes usage into a `{input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens}` dict, returns `None` when all fields are `None`, and derives `total_tokens` from input+output when missing. Handles both Pydantic and dict shapes.
- `_convert_responses_to_chat_result(response)` — extracts content from `response.output_text` (falling back to message `output_text` parts), attaches usage metadata, gathers Perplexity extras (search results, annotations) into `additional_kwargs`, and sets response metadata (model/id/status/created_at).
- `_convert_responses_stream_event_to_chunk(event)` — emits chunks for `response.output_text.delta` and `response.completed`, raises `PerplexityResponsesStreamError` on `response.error`/`response.failed`, returns `None` otherwise.
- `PerplexityResponsesStreamError` — structured attributes (`event_type`, `message`, `code`, `error_type`, `sequence_number`) with a detailed `__str__`.

- New `use_responses_api: bool | None` field (True forces Responses, False forces Chat Completions, None auto-detects).
